name: Save

requiredConfig.name: RPC connection
requiredConfig.description: Mainnet RPC the bridge or browser planner uses to query Save reserves and obligations. Cluster mismatches must be rejected with safety.action_not_exposed.

readCapabilities.returns: Per-reserve state: supply APY, borrow APY, utilization, collateral factor, liquidation threshold, deposit/borrow caps, liquidity.
Market-level state: program id, reserve count, total deposits and borrows, and per-reserve APY/utilization.
User obligation: supplied and borrowed reserves, total deposit/borrow value, borrow limit, liquidation threshold, health factor. Returns null when no obligation exists.
Projected obligation health factor for a hypothetical deposit, withdraw, borrow, or repay including breaches against the configured minimum.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount, supply APY, deposit cap, and the obligation snapshot. No transaction is signed at prepare time.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Save deposit transaction rebuilt at execute time with a refreshed reserve snapshot and fee payer set to the connected wallet.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount or withdrawAll flag, supplied balance, and the projected health preview.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Save withdraw transaction rebuilt at execute time. Refuses to execute if the projected health factor breaches the configured minimum.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount, borrow APY, borrow capacity, and the projected health preview.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Save borrow transaction rebuilt at execute time. Refuses to execute if the projected health factor breaches the configured minimum or the borrow limit is exceeded.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount or repayAll flag, and outstanding debt.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Save repay transaction rebuilt at execute time. Repay improves health, so no minimum-health gating is applied.

Reserve borrow APY for borrow/repay preparation

unsupportedRequests: Liquidate a Save obligation — liquidation flows are not exposed.
Flash loan from Save — not exposed.
Recursive leverage loops or automatic strategy management.
Deposit/borrow on tokens outside the known reserve list (SOL, USDC, USDT) without an explicit reserveMint.
Operate on any cluster other than mainnet-beta.
actionPreparationNotes: Resolve the reserve symbol from token input via resolveKnownReserve; if absent, require reserveMint. Read fresh reserve snapshot and obligation at prepare time and store reserveAddress, decimals, supplyApy/borrowApy, collateralFactor, liquidationThreshold, healthPreview, and the obligation snapshot in params. The execute path re-reads obligation and reserve, recomputes the health preview, and refuses borrow/withdraw if projected health is below the configured minimum.
riskNotes: Borrow and withdraw raise liquidation risk. The adapter rejects borrows or withdrawals whose projected health factor breaches the minimum threshold (default 1.10). High utilization may delay withdrawals; surface utilization and liquidity in the review card before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: Reads return facts without wallet involvement. Deposits, withdrawals, borrows, and repays build a transaction at execute time that the wallet must sign and broadcast. The agent never signs.
